column4: Retention users need an automatically generated monthly list of high-value members so they can identify and follow up with the previous month’s top sales customers.
column5: Monthly Auto Generation - System shall automatically generate/display the previous month’s Top Sales Customers on the 1st day of every month at 12:00 AM. - The displayed ranking shall be based on the previous month’s sales data. - Example: On 1 Sep 2026 at 12:00 AM, the system shall display the Top Sales Customers from Aug 2026.  Monthly Comparison - Display Previous Month Sales. - Display Previous Month W/L. - Display Current Month Sales. - Display Current Month W/L. - Current month figures should continue updating based on available system data.  Member Information - Rank. - Username. - Brand. - Phone Number. - VIP Level. - Last Active. - Last Followed Up By. - Last Followed Up Date. - Follow Up Status.  Filter & Search - Filter by Month. - Filter by Brand. - Filter by VIP Level. - Filter by PIC. - Search by Username / Phone Number.  Member Action - Provide a View action for each member. - Admin can open the selected member record for further review/follow-up.
column6: - At 12:00 AM on the 1st of each month, the page automatically changes to the newly completed previous month’s Top Sales list. - Ranking uses the correct previous month dataset. - Previous and current Sales / W&L values are displayed in separate columns. - Current month figures can update without changing the fixed previous-month ranking baseline. - All required member details are displayed. - Brand, VIP Level, PIC and Month filters return matching records. - Username / Phone Number search returns the correct member. - Follow-up information is displayed correctly. - Clicking View opens the selected member record.
